tonight.headline: The first win is locked — 131.8 to 88.62 with only Daniels left
body: Bad news first: Rashee Rice missed a second straight week with no return date, Garrett Wilson finished 8.4 on six targets, and C.J. Stroud's 23.0 sat on the bench.

It does not matter this week. Los Cachanillas are final at 88.62 and Bloodsports already have 131.8 with Jayden Daniels still to play Monday night at San Francisco — no quarterback score can lose a 43-point lead. ESPN shows 99% only because the game is not over. After 0-5, this is the first win. Nothing to do.

case.label: Why nothing
case.body: Every other starter is final; Golden finished 22.4 and Pickens 13.3 on 11 targets last night. Stroud, Worthy and Rice are final or out, so no bench player could replace Daniels even if he were scratched.

case.label: Daniels
case.body: Full practices and no designation (Commanders.com 15 Oct report; SI 17 Oct, carried). Washington are 7.5-point underdogs with a 51.5-52.5 total (Covers 19 Oct). Inactives come 16:45 CDMX.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing realistic: the lead is 43.2 and the opponent has no player left.

case.label: The bye
case.body: Washington (Daniels) and Jacksonville (Tuten) are on bye in Week 7 (ESPN file); Houston's is Week 8. Stroud was added on 17 Oct as this cover and threw three touchdowns in London today (archive, 23.0).

case.label: The running back
case.body: Tuten's Jacksonville bye: Josh Jacobs comes off the exempt list today, 19 Oct, and is eligible at Detroit; Fantasy Alarm (16 Oct) expects a split with MarShawn Lloyd in his first game and a full role by Week 8 or 9, and the league's conduct investigation remains open. Gordon is Miami's clear lead back after their bye (Yardbarker 18 Oct, carried). Tuesday's projection picks between them.

case.label: Not an override
case.body: A bye is a zero; this is a forced move, and it waits until Daniels has played Monday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Stroud is ruled out for Week 7, or Week 7 projections put a free quarterback more than two points above him and the swap is made anyway.

worthALook.name: Tyler Allgeier
worthALook.lead: On waivers until Wednesday 01:00 CDMX — and Bam Knight, who out-gained him, was only cramping.

case.label: The player
case.body: 18 carries and 2 targets for 5.8 in Arizona's 18-16 win; Knight 15 for 80 (archive). Knight's exit was full-body cramps, not an injury, and he goes back to third back 'whenever Love is ready' (azcardinals.com 18 Oct).

case.label: Why not now
case.body: IPADE priority never resets, and a back who lost the efficient half of a split to his backup is a patch, not a starter. Jacobs is expected to start for Green Bay in Week 7 (SI 18 Oct) and covers Tuten's bye with Gordon.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Only if Arizona rule Love out for Week 7 and the claim would start over Jacobs or Gordon for Tuten's bye. With Knight healthy, Allgeier is half a backfield — not a reason to spend priority that never resets.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Allgeier goes unclaimed and scores over 15 a game in Weeks 7-8 while Bloodsports' backs fall short.
